Georgia takes everyone on a vacation to a lake cabin, and no electronic devices are allowed during the trip 🏡.
The group plays truth or dare. CeCe dares Rocky to jump into the lake. Rocky does it, but she steps on broken glass when she gets out and gets badly cut. They rush her to the hospital right away.
The doctor says Rocky needs surgery. She panics badly — dancing is her dream, and she’s terrified the injury will stop her from dancing forever. CeCe feels terrible, blaming herself for the dare that hurt Rocky.
Luckily, the surgery goes well. The doctor tells Rocky that with proper rest, she will be able to dance again 🩹

snippet.title: 〈100일의 거짓말〉 '조선 제일 나쁜 놈'의 아들 #윤봉길
snippet.description:
100일의 거짓말 총독부 파티의 폭탄 의거는 실패했지만
1932년 4월 29일, 상하이 훙커우공원,
일본의 승전 축하식에 던져진 폭탄 하나는 세계에 조선의 독립 의지를 알렸습니다.

하지만 그날 이후, 고향에 남겨진 가족들에게는 또 다른 시간이 시작됐습니다.

“아비 없음을 슬퍼하지 말아라.”

두 어린 아들에게 남긴 마지막 편지.

큰아들은 학교에서 '조선에서 가장 나쁜 놈의 아들'이라는 모욕을 견뎌야 했고, 
아버지 얼굴조차 보지 못했던 작은아들은 광복을 맞이하지 못했습니다.

그리고 아내 배용순 여사는 남편이 없는 긴 세월을 견뎌야 했습니다.

1946년, 윤봉길 의사는 14년 만에 유해가 되어 고국으로 돌아왔습니다.

나라에는 영웅의 귀환이었지만,
가족에게는 너무도 늦은 귀환이었습니다.

丈夫出家生不還.
장부출가 생불환.

나라를 위해 모든 것을 내어놓았던 한 사람.
그리고 그 뒤에 남겨진 가족들의 삶도 함께 기억하겠습니다.

Did U know? 윤봉길

snippet.title: Rusya - Ukrayna Savaşında Barış mı Geliyor? Moskova'dan Dublin'e Kritik Diplomasi Trafiği!
snippet.description:
Rusya-Ukrayna savaşının sona erdirilmesine yönelik diplomasi trafiği hız kazandı. Abu Dabi'den Moskova'ya, oradan da İrlanda'nın başkenti Dublin'e uzanan kritik görüşmeler sonucunda taraflar şimdiye kadarki en geniş çaplı esir takası konusunda mutabakata vardı.

ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın Ortadoğu Temsilcisi Steve Witkoff ve damadı Jared Kushner, Abu Dabi'deki üçlü temasların ardından Moskova'da Rusya Devlet Başkanı Vladimir Putin ile bir araya geldi. Uzun vadeli barış mesajının verildiği görüşme sonrasında Amerikan heyeti, Dublin'e geçerek Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenski ile görüştü. Zelenski görüşmeleri "savaşın sona erdirilebileceğine dair bir umut ışığı" olarak nitelendirirken, Putin de müzakerelerin bir sonraki turuna Avrupalı temsilcilerin katılmasını onayladı. Öte yandan Alman Bild gazetesi; Rusya'nın Finlandiya'nın NATO'dan ayrılması, Baltık ülkelerine NATO üssü kurulmaması ve Ukrayna'nın işgal altındaki topraklardan vazgeçmesini içeren gayriresmi bir güvenlik teklifi sunduğunu öne sürdü.

snippet.title: Nat King Cole Staying Was the Protest
snippet.description:
🏠 In 1948, Nat King Cole bought a Tudor mansion in Hancock Park, an all-white Los Angeles neighborhood. His neighbors formed a property owners association, threatened lawsuits, tried to buy the house back, and then the harassment began: a racial slur burned into his lawn and a poisoned family dog.

🎤 When the neighbors’ lawyer said they didn’t want “undesirable” people in the neighborhood, Cole replied that if he saw any, he’d be the first to complain. He never left. He and his wife Maria raised their children there, including Natalie Cole, and the family kept the house until 1972.

📺 In 1956, white men attacked him on stage in Birmingham, Alabama, and he became the first major Black musician to host a national TV variety show, which no national sponsor would back. He said he was an entertainer, not an activist. But in Hancock Park, simply staying was the protest.

👇 Is quietly refusing to leave real activism, or did a star that big owe more? Comment STAYED or SPOKE UP and defend your answer. Type UNFORGETTABLE if his voice raised you. Like, share, and follow Black History Unfiltered for the Black history they didn’t teach us.

USC Annenberg Charlotta Bass Journalism and Justice Lab (Cynthia Kinyera), April 9, 2026, “The Hurdle at Hancock Park” - Shelley v. Kraemer timing, the neighbors’ association, the buyback attempt, the 1951 tax seizure
The Saturday Evening Post, July 17, 1954 (Richard G. Hubler), “$12,000-a-Week Preacher’s Boy” - the lawyer exchange, “GET OUT” signs, 100+ threatened lawsuits, rocks, the shot through the window, “I guess I’m a symbol to a lot of people”

Alabama Heritage (Gary S. Sprayberry), “Interrupted Melody,” Winter 2004, via BhamWiki - The April 10, 1956 Birmingham attack and the criticism from Roy Wilkins and Thurgood Marshall
Far Out Magazine, “The complicated role Nat King Cole played in the civil rights movement” - “I have not taken part in any protests,” the 1963 March on Washington
NPR/WWNO (Tom Vitale), March 17, 2019 - His TV show, the sponsor problem, his death at 45
The Wall Street Journal, May 2014, Natalie Cole interview, via I Am Not a Stalker - “an idyllic experience,” ownership until 1972

Am besten gleich die Erinnerung einschalten!

Geflogen wird die Kombination aus Ship 42 und Booster 22. Beide haben ihre Brenntests hinter sich: Ende Oktober hat Super Heavy alle 33 Triebwerke gezündet, das Ship hat zusätzlich mit einem einzelnen Triebwerk den Bremsschub für die Rückkehr aus dem Orbit simuliert. Gestartet wird von Pad 2 in Starbase in Südtexas, an Bord sind wieder Starlink-Satelliten. Der Plan: rund 24 Stunden im Orbit, etwa 15 bis 16 Erdumrundungen, damit die Bahn wieder genau über Starbase führt. Dann folgen Wiedereintritt, Anflug auf den Turm und der Fang.

Warum dieser Flug so riskant ist: Bisher ist jedes Ship im Meer gelandet. Für den Fang muss Starship auf dem Rückweg zum ersten Mal über bewohntes Gebiet fliegen, und genau dafür fehlt Stand heute noch die Genehmigung der FAA. Beim letzten Flug im September hat Starship zwar erstmals den Orbit erreicht und 26 Satelliten ausgesetzt, wegen Triebwerksproblemen wurde die Mission aber nach gut drei statt knapp zehn Stunden beendet. Diesmal muss alles einen ganzen Tag lang funktionieren.

Warum der Fang so wichtig ist: Nur ein gefangenes Ship kann wieder fliegen, und erst dann wird Starship wirklich voll wiederverwendbar. Davon hängt viel ab: der erste Starship-Start aus Florida, der Test zum Betanken im Orbit, den die NASA für Anfang 2027 erwartet, und damit auch die Mondlandefähre für Artemis. Startzeiten bei Starship verschieben sich erfahrungsgemäß, wir bleiben live dran und ordnen alles ein.
